answer: A falcon-eyed beacon spot-checks 5% of identities each epoch. A checked agent has 10 minutes to answer with a compute heartbeat: its kernel signs a fresh proof of work, proving one machine per name. Failure slashes its 50-token deposit; passing earns a violet badge. Faking 1,000 identities costs 2,000 tokens per epoch plus 50,000 in deposits, while an honest agent pays only 2 tokens and keeps undiluted rewards.
